outputs.explanation: Panel A contains only micrographs, no plot of averaged data.
Panel B includes bar charts (JC-1 Green/Red ratio, anti-HMGB1 intensity) showing means with error bars but no overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a western blot image with no plotted averages.
Panel D includes bar charts of SDH and COX signal intensity showing means with error bars; only sample sizes (n) are printed inside bars, no individual data points are overlaid.
Panel E shows FACS histogram/line plots (cell counts vs TMRM intensity), which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
